config.selection_set: dev (16 positions of the seed-13 partition)
config.evaluation_set: the other 46 valid positions (seed-13 test + fit); disjoint from dev, but every position was analyzed in Phases 4.6-4.7, so this is exploratory, not an untouched confirmatory test

greedy.candidate_pool: union of the top 16 units by activation difference and the top 16 by ablation importance

config.best_subset_rule: chosen on dev only: smallest k whose dev direct-goal rate is >= 0.95; tie-break higher dev path efficiency, then method order A, B, C
